description: Seed catalog (req-aws-core-livevalidation-catalog): per CloudFormation type, what the seed modules create and what the projection check compares. A type with no entry is unseeded, not free. entity_type is the manifest entity type; terraform is the resource type; compares lists manifest field names; tf_attrs maps each compared manifest field to where the expected value lives in the Terraform state (a path into the resource values, or an object: path+strip_suffix, all_true, const, join); natural_key is the same for the key; tags is tags_all (the state's merged tags) or none (the type cannot carry tags, expected {}); edges lists the manifest edges whose expected target comes from the state (target is a path, or a join over another state resource). Read by tools/seed/expected.py and tools/seed/compare.py.
